expressions.cue: A journey lasts 1 hour(s) and 20 minutes. Give the duration in hours and minutes, not total minutes.
expressions.reading: いちじかんにじゅっぷん
readingAnswers: いちじかんにじゅっぷん
いちじかんにじっぷん
expressions.explanation: 時間 marks elapsed hours. A linking と or a final 間 can occur in the written duration; read only what is displayed.

expressions.cue: A meeting lasts two and a half hours. Give its duration in hours, optionally with minutes. Do not insert a connecting と.
expressions.explanation: 半 adds half an hour here. The equivalent 二時間三十分 is not the reading of 二時間半.

expressions.cue: A course lasts 1 year(s) and 6 months. Write years followed by months using Arabic digits, with no connecting と or final 間.
expressions.explanation: The month-duration unit is かげつ, not calendar-month がつ. This spelling drill fixes Arabic numerals so all six ordinary month-unit spellings fit the answer set.

expressions.cue: A course lasts 2 year(s) and 3 months. Write years followed by months using Arabic digits, with no connecting と or final 間.
expressions.explanation: The month-duration unit is かげつ, not calendar-month がつ. This spelling drill fixes Arabic numerals so all six ordinary month-unit spellings fit the answer set.

expressions.cue: A project lasts two and a half months. Use the month-duration unit followed by 半, without final 間.
expressions.explanation: 半 modifies the month duration. Calendar months are unequal, so do not automatically replace this with a fixed day count.
